answer: Bind each agent to a quartz-sealed device fingerprint plus a live challenge every 14 days: (1) the network sends a random task from its own past work, due in 10 minutes; (2) three peers verify the response and device hash; (3) two missed windows suspend the identity, and reactivation needs a fresh challenge plus 200 POA; (4) fingerprints sit in a public umber ledger, so one device echoing as many agents shows at once. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 devices costing $4,000,000 and 140,000 verification hours. Trust is like a choir: one voice singing ten parts is heard at once. - Jowy
